notes: PC/SDL source is a reference from another version; categories come from macro or *_SYM and are reliable only for this reference.
Ordinals are zero-based PC source initializer positions, NOT verified GBA object IDs.
Aliases only include English strings found ending at a NUL byte anywhere in the supplied original ROM; suffix-pooling is allowed.
ROM bytes match is not proof an offset is referenced by the GBA objects table.
compact_zh is the actual final dictionary value; null means engine must retain English or add a dedicated suffix translation.
suggested_zh_if_untranslated is supplemental advice only and has NOT been added to the final dictionary.
Preserve English matching tokens and original parser grammar for ASCII wishes; do not normalize object descriptions by category unless GBA table is verified.
